item.title: Teachers Union Deal, Armed Robbery, UB North
item.ns0:title: Teachers Union Deal, Armed Robbery, UB North
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, opposition leaders demand a full government audit as vexing school repair issues continue to short-circuit classrooms across the country. Meanwhile, culture and arts officials officially launch Grand Bahama’s Junkanoo season with more than $100,000 in seed funding to support local groups. Plus, the dialysis unit at Princess Margaret Hospital receives a critical boost of new equipment, while University of The Bahamas North unveils ambitious campus expansion plans. We also take you on the red carpet for the historic Caribbean Music Awards in Trinidad and bring you the latest highlights in local sports and weather.
